أَجْلَهُ Bald in the fore part of the head; (S;) i. q. أَجْلَحُ: (TA:) or [it denotes more than the latter; meaning] bald in the greater part of the head: fem. جَلْهَآءُ: pl. جُلْهٌ. (Msb.) [See جَلَهٌ.] ―
-b2- Large in the forehead, having the places of growth of the hair receding. (K.) ―
-b3- (assumed tropical:) A bull having no horn; (Ks, JK, S, K;) like أَجْلَحُ. (Ks, S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
